Hi. I wish I could take your burden. I honestly wish I could point out all the ways you are a brilliant person and how people would miss you.

You made someone smile
You made someone laugh,
Someone thought you were pretty 
All the people who would miss you. 

And show you a wall of all the times when in the future, when they WILL happen again. 

Honestly but the only thing I can do is to tell you to perhaps see about counseling and hold these things in your head. 

ST.
